title: Derived direct image preserves direct sums
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact, quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For every set-indexed family $(E_i)$ of objects of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], the canonical map $\bigoplus_i Rf_*E_i\to Rf_*(\bigoplus_i E_i)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is an isomorphism.
